styles.art: Painted sci-fi video game art, cinematic lighting, rich color, high detail, retro-futurist 1990s space opera mood. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.
styles.planet: A single planet seen from space, perfectly centered, the entire sphere visible with a clear margin around it, dramatic light from the upper left with a dark night side on the lower right, thin glowing atmosphere rim where it has air. Painted sci-fi video game art, high detail. Pure black background, no stars, no moons, no text.
styles.portrait: Head and shoulders character portrait for a space strategy game, facing the viewer, inside a dim starship or palace interior with a softly blurred background, dramatic rim lighting. Highly detailed digital painting, cinematic, realistic. No text, no logos, no watermark.
styles.backdrop: Wide painted sci-fi video game background art, cinematic lighting, rich color, retro-futurist 1990s space opera mood. Calm composition with darker, low-contrast areas in the middle so menus drawn on top stay readable. No people in the foreground, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.

images.prompt: Epic title screen key art for a galactic empire strategy game. A huge ringed blue-green homeworld in the lower left, a golden sun flaring behind it, a vast purple and teal nebula filling the sky. A fleet of sleek warships in formation crosses from right to left, engines glowing, with a colossal flagship in front. A space station orbits the planet. Leave calm dark space in the upper middle third for a logo.

A deep space backdrop for a galaxy strategy map: very dark, mostly black, with faint wisps of blue, violet and teal nebula and a soft dusty glow of a distant spiral galaxy arm. Subtle and low contrast so small markers drawn on top stay readable. No planets, no ships, no bright stars.

A dark space battlefield backdrop seen from above: the curved limb of a planet at the bottom edge, faint red nebula, scattered debris and distant explosions. Dark and low contrast in the middle so ships drawn on top stay readable. No ships in the foreground.

Triumphant scene: a grand imperial capital city of gleaming spires at golden sunrise on an alien world, banners waving, a parade fleet of starships flying overhead in formation, fireworks in the sky. Heroic and glorious.
Somber scene: a ruined, burning capital city on an alien world at dusk, broken spires and smoke, wrecked starships falling from a red sky, a lone tattered banner. Tragic and quiet.
A lush paradise world: vivid emerald continents, turquoise shallow seas, white swirling clouds, glowing healthy blue atmosphere.
An Earth-like world: green and brown continents, deep blue oceans, white clouds, polar ice caps.
An ocean world covered almost entirely by deep blue water, small scattered islands, large white storm spirals.
A swamp world: murky olive-green wetlands, brown river deltas, dense hazy yellow-green clouds.
An arid savanna world: tan and ochre plains, dry riverbeds, thin strips of olive vegetation, a few small seas, sparse clouds.
A tundra world: frozen white and pale blue ice plains, grey rock, patches of dark moss, thin wispy clouds.
A desert world: orange and red sand dunes, canyons, dry salt flats, no water, a thin dusty atmosphere.
A barren airless world: grey cratered rock like a moon, no atmosphere, sharp shadows.
A radiated world: scorched dark rock with sickly glowing lime-green and violet radiation storms and auroras.
A toxic world wrapped in thick swirling sulfur-yellow and acid-green poisonous clouds.
An inferno world: black crust cracked by glowing rivers and seas of orange lava, volcanic smoke.
Instead of a planet, a dense round cluster of grey and brown rocky asteroids of many sizes floating together, lit from the upper left.
A gas giant with banded cream, rust and amber cloud belts, a large oval storm, and thin faint rings.
A stern grey-haired human woman fleet admiral with a scar over one eyebrow, dark navy uniform with gold epaulettes.
A young human male starfighter ace with short dark hair and a confident grin, flight suit with an open helmet collar.
A tall reptilian warrior captain with copper scales, a crest of bony horns and amber slit eyes, wearing battered black armor.
A many-eyed cephalopod-like alien tactician with glossy violet skin and short facial tentacles, wearing a silver command harness.
A rugged bald human mercenary commander with a cybernetic red eye and a thick beard, worn leather and armor plates.
A sleek android starship captain with a pale porcelain face, glowing cyan seams and calm expression, white and blue uniform.
A blue-skinned humanoid woman corsair captain with silver braided hair, a long dark coat and a confident smirk.
A massive armored crustacean-like alien commander with a teal shell, mandibles and small glowing eyes, wearing a red sash.
A battle-hardened human woman marine general with a shaved head and tattoos on her neck, green camouflage armor.
An elderly furry alien commodore resembling a wise owl-badger hybrid, spectacles, decorated blue coat with medals.
A gaunt grey-skinned alien strategist with a high domed head, black eyes and a high collar of dark crimson robes.
A young human man with a long ponytail and a hawkish face, wearing an elegant black and gold naval dress uniform.
A kindly middle-aged human woman planetary governor with greying curly hair and warm eyes, an elegant teal robe and a jeweled chain of office.
An eccentric old human scientist administrator with wild white hair, magnifying goggles pushed up on the forehead, lab coat over a waistcoat.
A plump, cheerful frog-like alien merchant-banker with gold rings and a velvet purple jacket, holding a data slate.
A graceful plant-like alien sage with bark-textured skin, leafy fronds for hair and small glowing flowers, wearing a moss-green mantle.
A sharp-featured human man industrial magnate with slicked silver hair, a pinstripe high-collared suit and a monocle display.
A serene alien woman with pearlescent lilac skin, large luminous eyes and a jeweled circlet, a diplomat in flowing white robes.
A stocky dwarf-like humanoid miner-engineer with a braided red beard, a soot-smudged face and a heavy work exosuit.
A crystalline mineral-based alien administrator with a faceted amethyst face and soft inner glow, wearing a bronze collar.
A young human woman agronomist governor with dark skin, close-cropped hair and a bright smile, a practical green field jacket.
A sly fox-like furry alien treasurer with russet fur, narrow clever eyes and an ornate high-collared coat of black and gold.
An ancient insect-like alien archivist with a pale chitin face, delicate antennae and many thin arms, wrapped in grey robes.
A charismatic human man populist governor in his fifties with a neat beard and a crimson sash over a white suit, raising a hand to a crowd.

View from high orbit over a colonized alien world at the day-night terminator: glittering city lights spreading over the night side, a thin blue atmosphere, an orbital ring station with docking arms, small shuttles trailing light.

A vast futuristic research laboratory inside a space station: towering glowing blue holographic star charts and molecule models, a containment chamber with a swirling energy core, catwalks and soft cyan light.

An orbital shipyard drydock in space: a half-built sleek warship skeleton held in a lattice of scaffolding and welding arms, sparks and work lights, a planet glowing below, faint blueprint-like grid lines in the dark.

A great war fleet assembling in orbit of a moon: dozens of distant starships of many sizes in loose formation with glowing engines, a carrier in the middle distance, deep blue space and a pale nebula.
A grand galactic council chamber: a circular amphitheater of ornate balconies for alien delegations under a vast domed window showing a spiral galaxy, golden light, banners of many empires.

A dark intelligence operations room: walls of glowing red and green surveillance holograms showing alien cities and fleets, a central holographic table, deep shadows, rain on a window behind showing a neon alien city at night.
An officers' hall aboard a flagship: a long polished deck with tall windows to space, rows of empire banners, ceremonial armor on stands, warm amber and blue light.
An imperial throne hall high in a spire overlooking a gleaming planet-wide capital city at dusk, giant windows, marble and brass, a holographic galaxy map floating above a dais.
The bridge of a starship: crew stations with glowing amber and blue consoles in the foreground silhouetted, and a huge forward viewscreen showing a distant star system and incoming fleet signals.

music.prompt: Main menu theme for a grand space strategy game about building a galactic empire. Slow, majestic and wondrous: soft synth pads and shimmering arpeggios open into a sweeping orchestral swell with warm brass, choir and timpani, then settles back to a calm, mysterious ambience. Retro 90s sci-fi game soundtrack feel, cinematic, instrumental, no vocals.

Calm background music for long play sessions of a space empire strategy game. Spacious ambient electronic with gentle analog synth pads, slow bell-like arpeggios, soft strings and a distant pulse. Contemplative, hopeful, unobtrusive, steady volume with no big climaxes. Instrumental, no vocals.

Background music for a space strategy game while planning wars and research. Mysterious and slightly tense ambient: low cello drones, sparse piano notes, glassy synth textures, slow evolving harmony, a subtle steady rhythm. Unobtrusive, steady volume. Instrumental, no vocals.
Intense space battle music for a strategy game: driving taiko and orchestral percussion, urgent staccato strings, bold brass stabs and pulsing synth bass. Instrumental, no vocals.
Triumphant victory fanfare for a space strategy game: heroic brass, choir and timpani building to a glorious major-key finale. Instrumental.
Somber defeat theme for a space strategy game: slow mournful solo horn over low strings and a distant choir, minor key, fading out. Instrumental.
